title: An Effective Two-Sided Rate for the Diagonal Beta Value
description: Upgrades the asymptotic B(n+1,n+1) ~ √(πn)/((2n+1)·4ⁿ) to an explicit two-sided rate valid for all n ≥ 1. Writing the correction as ratioR n = stirlingSeq n²/(√π·stirlingSeq(2n)), Mathlib’s effective Stirling bounds pin it to √(2π)/e ≤ ratioR n ≤ e²/(2π) (ratioR_ge / ratioR_le), yielding (√(2π)/e)·√(πn)/((2n+1)·4ⁿ) ≤ betaDiag n ≤ (e²/(2π))·√(πn)/((2n+1)·4ⁿ) with constants ≈ 0.922 and 1.176. Honest constant-factor envelope. 0 axioms, 0 sorries.
